notes: Valid JSON, 2-space indent, version 1.5.0 matches the release under audit.
Asserts exit 3 and envelope code 3 for unwritable stdout on claim batch, multi-id done and done --batch; tests pass.

Block judged per id under the lock before any write (probed exit 1, task file untouched); batch result claimed/failed are make()'d so serialize as []; batch uses printResultOrExit. Pre-existing: claimSingle returns output.JSON's error rather than exiting 3 on an unwritable stdout (not a 1.5.0 change).

Round-6 fix held. Probed with a git shim refusing the 3rd add: exit 3, stdout empty, stderr {code:3,commit_sha:<HEAD short sha>,error,hint:'application commit <sha> already landed; recover with `git add spec.tasks.json && git commit --amend --no-edit`; do not re-run tp commit or tp done...'}; text mode prints hint + commit_sha line. Running the hinted recovery left a clean tree. Info: paths in the hint are space-joined unquoted, so a task-file path with a space would not paste verbatim.

Probed in a mktemp repo bound to epic b (blocked by c): next/next --peek exit 4 with {blocked_by_epics:[c],done:false,message}; ready exit 0 {ready:[],blocked_by_epics}, --first exit 4; claim/claim --all-ready/commit/done exit 1 with blocked_by_epics + actionable hint. BlockedBy is depends_on order (deterministic), ready is [] never null; stdout write failure exits 3 via printResultOrExit.
24 functions assert blocked_by_epics, exit codes 1/3/4 and the unbound notice per command; ran the Blocked/TestClaim_/TestCommit_Refuses subset: ok.

BlockedBy initialised to []string{} (never null), appended in depends_on order; unbound file returns nil without reading the graph; ignored binding sets Notice; unreadable graph/bound file is an error the CLI maps to exit 3.
Covers direct-deps-only blocking, done record clearing, absent epic / no graph notice, unbound file not reading a malformed graph; tests pass.

epic-blocked sits in the documented fixed order, class escalate, data {epic, blocked_by_epics}; message dropped under --compact (probed: tp resume --json --compact showed code/class/data only, next_units []). blockers never nil.

Read the v1.4.1..HEAD diff (lifecycle, command index, Epic Graph section): the epic-block contract (next/ready/claim name blocked_by_epics, resume reports epic-blocked, wip still finishes) matches probed behaviour; exit codes in the index lines match.
Manifest only (version 1.5.0); nothing in this role's domain.
Pins the stdout-write error as exit 3 for claim batch, done multi and done --batch; fixture writes 0o600, errors checked.

refuseBlockedClaim runs inside WithFileLock on the file read under the lock (42-49), before any write; batch output now goes through printResultOrExit (215), so the write error exits 3 instead of being dropped. Pre-existing: claimSingle returns output.JSON's error unclassified (145).

refuseBlockedCommit runs under the lock before staging/writing (81). The two former `_ = runGit*` drops are now unstageLockFilesOrExit (280-285) and stageClosureOrExit (352-362), exit 3 with commit_sha and recovery hint. Pre-existing, by §5.1d design: a failed amend falls back to a follow-up commit (301), and foldErr is a stderr warning with exit 0 (173-175).

Read-only helpers; every EpicBlockFor error exits 3 with epicBoundFileHint (36-40); printResultOrExit propagates the stdout write error as exit 3 (81-86). Called under the callers' WithFileLock. Probe in a mktemp repo: blocked tp claim t1 exits 1 with blocked_by_epics and leaves spec.tasks.json byte-identical.
Fixtures write 0o600 files and 0o750 dirs via filepath.Join; every error is require.NoError-checked; no `_ =` drops.

Pure read path; paths from filepath.Dir/DiscoverTPDir/LoadEpicGraph (filepath.Join); graph, bound-index and derive errors all propagated (45-47, 56-58, 79-85, 98-101); only ErrEpicGraphNotFound is mapped to a notice, via errors.Is. Pre-existing: LoadEpicGraph's `_ = json.Unmarshal` after a proven typed parse (epicgraph.go, not 1.5.0).
0o750 dir / 0o600 file writes via filepath.Join; errors checked.
epicBlockedBlocker (133-147) is pure over BlockerInputs; nil-guarded EpicBlock; no I/O, no writes. hasOpenTasks export is a rename only.
Documentation; the 1.5.0 diff adds no lock, permission or error-handling claims in this role's domain.
Only change is version 1.4.1 -> 1.5.0 per the release rule; nothing else in this role's domain.
envelopeCode helper documented with t.Helper(); three tests documented with the failure they reject; no TODO; lint clean.

claimTargets documented; claimBatch's dropped JSON write error now goes through printResultOrExit (exit 3). runClaim 65 lines, claimBatch 69. runClaim's gocognit baseline entry is pre-existing; the ratchet script passes.

gitIndexHint, unstageLockFilesOrExit, stageClosureOrExit documented; two ignored `_ = runGit` results replaced by exit-3 handling. runCommit is 135 lines (134 at v1.4.1, +1 net), pre-existing and in scripts/baseline-funlen.txt; check-complexity passes in a clone.

All 11 functions documented and <=25 lines; every helper has a caller (done.go, next.go, ready.go, claim.go, commit.go); JSON ready list is []model.Task{} not nil; blocked_by_epics only printed non-empty. golangci-lint, check-complexity, check-deadcode clean in a clone. printResultOrExit reuses groundStdoutHint (ground-named but its text is generic).
Helpers documented and t.Helper()-marked; each test names its spec row and the failing implementation it rejects; no TODO/FIXME; lint clean.

EpicBlock/EpicBlockFor documented; BlockedBy initialized []string{} so the blocker's blocked_by_epics never serializes null. EpicBlockFor returns LoadEpicGraph/EpicBoundFiles errors unwrapped (L46,L57); those already name the file (test asserts c.tasks.json on stderr), so no context is lost. EpicBlockFor is 36 lines.
Fixture helpers documented, reuse statusChain/boundFilesRepo; no TODO; lint clean.

New EpicBlock field and epicBlockedBlocker documented; BuildBlockers doc updated to list epic-blocked in code order; hasOpenTasks exported as HasOpenTasks with a doc comment and used by cli; Data blocked_by_epics comes from the non-nil BlockedBy. Field populated in resume.go:158.

New commands (tp set --epic, tp init --epic, tp epic gate/done/claim/ready/status, export JSON) listed in the command index; stale 'comes in a later release' sentence removed; no TODO. 'The graph gates the work' names next/ready/claim/resume but not the tp done/tp commit refusals (prose scope only).
